headline: Sewer abatements for five properties, plus change orders for River Terrace and Wistariahurst projects.
summary: The agenda lists a contract amendment with the Office of Community Development for an ARPA-funded sewer rehabilitation project, along with Holyoke Water Works items. It also includes a wastewater treatment plant contract update and a proposal to adjust sewer bills to resolve past balances, including interest.
items: Holyoke Water Works and DPW contract
Draft Holyoke Water Works request for cost participation
Wistariahurst Change Order No. 2 to extend wall limits due to additional MHC funding
River Terrace CSO Sewer Separation Phase Change Order No. 8 to revise paving rehabilitation method for George and Jefferson St. (vote)
Contract amendment with the Office of Community Development for the ARPA-funded City's Sewer System Rehabilitation Project (vote)
Sewer update on the wastewater treatment plant contract
Adjustment to wastewater treatment facility sewer bills to resolve past balances, including interest
Consent agenda: City Engineer and Assistant Engineer report and DPW Director report
Other topics the Chair did not anticipate 48 hours in advance
Possible executive session on collective bargaining or litigation
location: DPW Conference Room, Pellissier Building, 63 North Canal Street, or by Zoom
